objective_for_doctor:
Age: 71
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have a cough that produces colored or more abundant sputum than usual, a cough, and noticed a wheezing sound when you exhale

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi doctor. I’ve been having a cough that brings up colored sputum more than usual, and I also hear a wheezing sound when I exhale. With my COPD, this feels like one of my flare-ups, and I’m still a current smoker.
[ASK] Are you experiencing **Acute COPD exacerbation / infection**?
Yes, I think so. I’ve had a few COPD flare-ups in the past year, and right now my cough is worse with more colored sputum than usual, plus wheezing when I breathe out.
I’m not sure. I don’t know if it’s pneumonia, but I do have the COPD flare-up symptoms—coughing more colored sputum than usual and wheezing.
I can’t say for sure. I haven’t noticed anything specific that tells me it’s pneumonia—I just know my COPD symptoms are worse: more colored sputum and wheezing when I exhale.
No, I’m not sure it’s pneumonia—I don’t have any clear signs that it’s pneumonia. Mostly it feels like my COPD symptoms are flaring up more: cough with more colored sputum and wheezing when I exhale.
No, I’m not experiencing tuberculosis. I don’t have anything I’d recognize as TB symptoms, and I haven’t had recent international travel.
